content.title: Valero Energy says it will buy Venezuelan crude from three sellers
content.summary: By Nicole Jao and Vallari Srivastava Jan 29 (Reuters) - Valero Energy has engaged ​with three authorized sellers of ‌Venezuelan crude and will purchase barrels from all ‌three of them, it said on a conference call on Thursday. The refiner did not disclose the sellers, ⁠but added that ‌it expects Venezuelan crude will make up a "pretty large ‍part of its heavy crude diet" in February and March.

content.title: Valero’s Venezuelan Crude Deal Reshapes Feedstock Flexibility And Margins
content.summary: Valero Energy (NYSE:VLO) has secured imports of Venezuelan crude under a new U.S. approved export agreement. The arrangement gives Valero access to additional heavy crude supplies for its Gulf Coast refineries. This development affects how U.S. refiners source feedstock and could influence product output and fuel oil usage.
